selection: Four convenience probes selected only from commit subjects and file statistics before detector execution: extraction, undefined-behavior edit, memcpy refactor, OpenCV refactor. All changed C/C++ source/header files; no outcome-based replacement. Not a random sample or held-out final evaluation.

source_review.method: Read all frozen source.diff hunks and their enclosing source. Expectations fixed before srcDiff/srcMove execution. Eight targets include exact, normalized and edited transfers, not assumed Type-3. No population accuracy claim. Full inlined loop-to-memcpy rewrite has no same-construct identity asserted; additions/documentation edits are not moves.
